connector.name: Boltwork
connector.registryDescription: AI services via Bitcoin Lightning - PDF summarisation, code review, translation and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package boltwork-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the squidboy30 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NWC_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string (e.g. from Alby or Mutiny). Required if not using Phoenixd.

env.name: PHOENIXD_URL
env.description: Phoenixd base URL e.g. http://localhost:9740. Required if not using NWC.

env.name: PHOENIXD_PASSWORD
env.description: Phoenixd HTTP Basic auth password. Required if using Phoenixd.
